jsonld_raw.name: (540 G) LUMINOUS CAMELLIA SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made with vegetable waxes.

Luminous Camellia | A delicate and vibrant fragrance, in which the luminous petals of the camellia flower trace a path of suggestive fruit and citrus juice, stirring the strength of the earth that illuminates them and the spirit of the driest amber.

Notes:
Top: floral, fruity pear, fresh green.
Heart: freesia, rose petals, jasmine.
Base: dry amber, patchouli, musk.
